messages:
Noah Kim: kicking off CatalystOne onboarding. quick sync to map stakeholders, define success criteria, and lock first 30 days. will be terse.

Noah Kim: Quick goals:
- Staging integration + automated smoke tests green
- p50/p95 latency targets defined for demo traffic
- 2 enablement sessions + short howto clips
- Baseline metrics captured for renewal story

Jade Rivera: I'll run the integration playbook with their eng lead. Need SSO info and any IP allowlist.

Omar Bashir: I'll provision a dedicated staging pool. ETA day 3. Note: for initial demo keep batch size small to meet latency SLO.

Hannah Lee: CS ops will build the 30/60/90 checklist and backlog. I'll add onboarding KPIs: activation (calls/day), avg latency, and first-week error rate.

Priyanka Das: Security items: provide standard pen-test scope and SAML flow doc. Their compliance team requires dataflow diagram before test. Can someone draft it?

Noah Kim: @Omar can you grab model pipeline diagram (tokens, kv cache, logs) so Priya can combine into dataflow?

Omar Bashir: on it. will post a diagram link and staging endpoint by EOD day 2.

DeployBot: Deployment scheduled: staging-pool-catalystone on 2026-05-02T09:00Z (auto-notify in #eng-deploys).

Jade Rivera: Proposed timeline:
Day 0-4: discovery + SSO + infra prep
Day 5-12: API integration + smoke tests
Day 13-17: pilot replay + perf tuning (batching/kv cache)
Day 18-30: customer demo, enablement, handoff to support

Hannah Lee: Add a finance check on Day 10. Their initial commit has flexible capacity but billing needs PO for >$10k monthly. We should confirm spike path.

Noah Kim: Renewal note: contract auto-renews in 10 months. Let's capture MRR-impacting metrics early. Suggest we define a "value pack" metric set: tokens/latency/cost-per-inference + support load reduction.

Priyanka Das: Pen-test: customer wants scope by Day 8. I'll attach our standard scope. If they request contract changes, loop legal.

Jade Rivera: Enablement plan: two sessions (dev walkthrough + ops runbook). I'll schedule live sessions week of May 11 and May 18 and record both.

Omar Bashir: sample curl for staging (temp token):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer stg_tok_zz123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-compact","prompt":"hi"}'
```

Omar Bashir: responses include latency_ms and model_version in the header. we'll surface to their dashboard.

Hannah Lee: Action items captured:
- Omar: staging pool + curl + diagram (Due Day 3)
- Priyanka: pen-test scope + SAML doc (Due Day 4)
- Jade: enablement schedule + decks (Dates May 11 & May 18)
- Noah: baseline metric plan + renewal metric list (Due Day 2)
- Hannah: finance checkpoint Day 10 + playbook (shared)

Noah Kim: Risk log quick hits:
- SOC review could push demo if pen-test delayed
- PO process for spikes might block scale tests
- Customer data residency question 

Jade Rivera: I'll add data residency note to discovery. Also asking their SRE for contact.

Priyanka Das: Their compliance wants logs retention policy. I'll send our default retention and a short Q&A doc.

Omar Bashir: For pilot load: Redwood will kick off a 1hr replay (Day 14) to capture p95 under controlled conditions, then customer-run longer test Day 16. Need to confirm traffic profile.

Noah Kim: please react with :white_check_mark: when you've confirmed your items.

Jade Rivera: :white_check_mark:

Omar Bashir: :white_check_mark:

Priyanka Das: :white_check_mark:

Hannah Lee: :white_check_mark:
